display.purpose: Page headings and high-emphasis metric values.

label.purpose: Metadata, provenance, statuses, and chart keys.

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Press, hover, and compact control transitions.

motion.name: smooth-out
motion.purpose: Default positional easing for deliberate state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next meaningful action, using the sole accent color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary), white 12%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary operation that remains visible without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--graphite-700); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact dark field with persistent border and explicit focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--graphite-700); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Workspace Card
components.description: A tonal operational container with a fine seam and no resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 16px/1.375 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 11px/1.45 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current workspace route, expressed with the single signal color.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary), white 12%); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact status that pairs semantic wording with a restrained tint.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 18%, var(--card)); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 7%, var(--card)); color: var(--success); font: 500 11px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Analytics Series Key
components.description: A persistent non-hover legend for public and engaged view series.
components.css: .ds-chart-key { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 11px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-chart-key span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-chart-key span::before { width: 14px; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--chart-2); content: ''; } .ds-chart-key .ds-series-engaged::before { background: var(--chart-1); }

narrative.overview: Shorts Studio feels like a calm production desk: dark graphite equipment surfaces, warm readable type, and one lime action signal. It is dense enough for active creator work without turning analytics, publishing, or media review into a decorative dashboard. The supplied gaming video is the Dashboard's sole focal image. Operational routes keep imagery subordinate to evidence, state, and action. Familiar controls, honest unavailable states, and restrained motion let the workspace disappear into the task.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite tonal layers separated by fine borders rather than shadows.
Lime reserved for primary actions, current selection, and meaningful state.
Compact metric rails, tabular numerals, and explicit data provenance.
One responsive shell shared by capture, editorial, publishing, analytics, and revenue.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime identifies action, selection, or live meaning; it never fills inactive decoration.

rules.name: The Truth Has a Label Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, failure, unavailable, estimated, and derived states always include words or structure in addition to hue.

rules.name: The Operate-Type Rule
rules.body: Controls and data labels stay fixed-size and compact; no fluid display typography enters task surfaces.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layer Rule
rules.body: A surface earns separation through background value and border contrast before any shadow is considered.

dos: Do preserve semantic tokens, visible focus, readable labels, and responsive source rows.
Do keep operational hierarchy compact enough that the next decision remains nearby.
Do provide textual and tabular alternatives for color-coded or plotted data.
Do keep the supplied hero video separate from uploaded source media and preserve its provenance.
Do limit motion to 150–250ms state feedback, explicit progress, and intentional disclosure; honor reduced motion and keyboard input.
donts: Don't add another dashboard shell or hero to Analytics, Revenue, or future routes.
Don't render retained Efferd references as product UI; they inform hierarchy only.
Don't fabricate metrics, fill missing dates with zero, or enable Phase 8 processing through previews.
Don't animate routine polling or chart refreshes, or make animation necessary to understand an action.
Don't imitate glass, metal, bevels, or other physical materials with CSS effects.
